subject.title: Add Codex fork-family provenance and missing-parent dedupe (#2037)

question: Should missing-parent provenance land as an independent slice, or should this PR become the combined landing candidate with the interleaved containment from https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2066?
rationale: The branch intentionally combines two accounting policies with different proof status and undercount tradeoffs, so code review alone cannot choose the permanent landing boundary.

options.title: Split provenance slice
options.body: Rebase the missing-parent dedupe and its fixtures onto main or the eventually merged containment base for independent review and proof.

options.title: Review combined redesign
options.body: Keep the stack and require combined upgrade, cold/warm cache, undercount, and real-corpus proof before landing.

options.title: Pause billing suppression
options.body: Retain the fixture and specification work while deferring the provisional production suppression policy.

recommendation.title: Split provenance slice
recommendation.body: Rebase the missing-parent dedupe and its fixtures onto main or the eventually merged containment base for independent review and proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this person to the scanner orchestration, cache contract, adjacent merges, and cancellation behavior that determine the safe landing boundary.
